title: Joys of the Chosen and a Friend in Hell

paragraphs.text: The painful punishment described before is not for everyone. The chosen servants of Allah are kept apart from it. Instead, they will receive a provision which has already been decided for them, including many kinds of fruits, and they will be treated with honor. They will live in gardens of pleasure and sit on thrones, facing one another as friends. A cup filled from a flowing spring will be passed around among them. The drink will be white and delicious for everyone who tastes it. It will not cause any bad effect, and it will not make them lose their minds. With them will be women who lower their eyes and have large, beautiful eyes. They will be as pure as delicate eggs which are carefully protected.

While they enjoy this, the people of Paradise will turn to one another and ask each other about their lives. One of them will say that on earth he had a companion who used to question his faith. This companion would ask him whether he was really one of those who believed. He would also ask whether, after they died and became dust and bones, they would truly be brought back and paid back for their deeds. The speaker will then ask the others whether they would like to look down. When he looks, he will see his old companion in the middle of the Hellfire. Then he will call out to him, "By Allah, you almost destroyed me."
